name: Alisha Gupta
role: Public Health Speciality Registrar and NIHR Academic Clinical Fellow
bio:
Dr Alisha Gupta, BMBS is a Public Health Speciality Registrar and NIHR Academic Clinical Fellow, following completion of the Specialised Foundation Programme (2023-2025) in the North East.

She works within Academic Public Health, as part of the North East and North Cumbria Deep End Research Team and the Health Inequalities Team at the Population Health Sciences Institute. She also works with the NIHR Partnership for Workforce Sustainability.
